paper_title: Automatic Evaluation of Attribution by Large Language Models
caption: Data source distribution of combined training and AttrEval-Simulation sets.
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of data sources within the AttrEval-Simulation dataset. The chart is divided into five segments, representing POP-QA (red, 21.6%), HOTPOTQA (dark blue, 24.2%), ENTITYQUEST (light blue, 26.0%), TRIVIAQA (green, 22.7%), and TREC (yellow, 1.9%). The chart includes a legend identifying each segment's label and a percentage value is displayed within each slice. The segments appear ordered visually by descending size, with ENTITYQUEST being the largest and TREC the smallest.
